answer: A farm running 73 keys cannot self-supply these, as each counter-bonding peer must be independent on the jetty graph and each one exposes its own stake to the same slash. Since the walnut escrow holds both sides, recruiting real counterparties is the operator's cost, and the vault audit releases each pair. Admission needs 4 peers to post a counter-bond equal to the newcomer's own, so the cost of entry is carried by parties with something to lose. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
